plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and maintaining a cash buffer.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to small positions to reduce overall leverage.
Trim QQQI to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate.
Buy TSLA at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality growth.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some exposure to leveraged assets while reducing overall concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month growth with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad index with quality tech and a small amount of leveraged exposure.

plan: Add to all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to 6% each, leaning into leverage for growth.
Trim QQQI to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate.
Buy TSLA at 6% as a strong scanner setup, concentrating in high-scoring names.
This plan uses leverage and concentration to stretch for growth, accepting higher risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. Be aware of significantly higher drawdown risk and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero for income focus.
Add to QQQI to 30% to increase exposure to income-generating ETFs.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It prioritizes income over growth, but remember distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
